behavior: Accepted quote, chosen current version, displayed revision and coherent relations are rechecked in one serializable transaction before order creation

The Commercial role may create only the order claimed by this action; no general project/order update, deletion, stock or invoice permission is added
An agency-limited role needs an existing accessible project; no agency is silently assigned
A coherent existing order is returned unchanged on replay, without another audit; two same-process SQLite callers created one dossier
Generated project dates use the company calendar and installation dates remain calendar dates
The UI retains its launch revision and form values on refusal; controls are frozen during submission; deposit text no longer claims an invoice was created
